aaaaaa.name: AAAAAA
aaaaaa.desc: Sound moves always result in a critical hit.

ablaze.name: ABLAZE
ablaze.desc: When any Pokemon on this team is at 33% or less HP, its STAB moves have 1.5x power.

absent.name: ABSENT
absent.desc: Pokemon on this team cannot have their stats lowered.

alt.name: ALT
alt.desc: Trick Room is set or removed at the end of every turn while this Pokemon is on the field.

bees.name: BEES

block.name: BLOCK
block.desc: This team's active Pokemon gains immunity to foe's pivot moves.

bootie.name: BOOTIE

bounty.name: BOUNTY

bugsy.name: BUGSY

burn.name: BURN
burn.desc: This Pokemon's contact moves have a 100% chance to burn the target.

chip.name: CHIP
chip.desc: Attacking moves cause the target to lose an additional 1/16th of their max HP. Multi-hit moves only activate this effect once.

coffee.name: COFFEE
coffee.desc: Pokemon on this team skip recharge turns at the cost of 20% of the move's power.

crash.name: CRASH
crash.desc: The opponent's first Pokemon also has Slow Start.

drake.name: DRAKE
drake.desc: This team's Dragon type moves ignore Fairy type immunity.

eggs.name: EGGS

enby.name: ENBY

espeon.name: ESPEON

exequy.name: EXEQUY

fast.name: FAST

fest.name: FEST
fest.desc: This Pokemon gains Celebrate as a 5th move.

fish.name: FISH
fish.desc: This Pokemon has the Water type.

fluffy.name: FLUFFY

four.name: FOUR
four.desc: The opponent's team is trimmed to 4 Pokemon. Does not break their code.
four.effectDetails: Before the battle, the opponent's team is cut to 4 Pokemon if it was larger. The opponent's code retains all of its effects as if the team was not trimmed.

gene.name: GENE
gene.desc: If this Pokemon has no Item, it gains +2 Attack and becomes confused on switch-in.

gitgud.name: GITGUD
gitgud.desc: Pokemon on this team heal 1/8th max HP and raise their lowest stat by 1 (counting stat stage changes) if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.

go.name: GO
go.desc: This Pokemon's attacks have +2 priority and scatter coins.

gofish.name: GOFISH
gofish.desc: The team gains a boost to all stats (except Spe, acc, and eva) equal to 5% * the number of types shared by more than one team member.

gold.name: GOLD
gold.desc: This Pokemon gains Good as Gold.

heal.name: HEAL
heal.desc: This Pokemon uses Heal Bell when it switches in.

i.name: I
i.desc: On switch-in, gain 1 in all stats (except acc/eva).

iron.name: IRON
iron.desc: All Pokemon gain a Quark Drive boost that can stack with Quark Drive. Steel types: immune to indirect damage, use Defense when attacking if higher than Attack.

lazy.name: LAZY
lazy.desc: Pokemon with the Drowsy condition can't switch while this Pokemon is on the field.

life.name: LIFE
life.desc: This Pokemon heals 1/8 max HP after attacking.

lmfao.name: LMFAO
lmfao.desc: All weather- and terrain-setting moves switch the user out on this team.

luck.name: LUCK
luck.desc: This Pokemon gains +2 Crit ratio, and has its moves' secondary effect chances doubled.

mega.name: MEGA
mega.desc: If this Pokemon has a Mega form, excluding Z forms, it immediately Mega Evolves, without needing to hold a mega stone. Evolves into the X form if this Pokemon has an Attack-boosting nature, otherwise evolves into the Y form.

neuter.name: NEUTER
neuter.desc: All Pokemon on this team have Neutralizing Gas.

noclip.name: NOCLIP
noclip.desc: Terrains have no effect. All Pokemon gain immunity to hazards, and all moves bypass Substitute and screens.

nuke.name: NUKE
nuke.desc: When this Pokemon faints, it uses Explosion.

okay.name: OKAY
okay.desc: Moves used by or against this Pokemon deal neutral damage.

paid.name: PAID

pika.name: PIKA
pika.desc: This Pokemon gains Volt Tackle as a 5th move.

pride.name: PRIDE
pride.desc: This team gains a Mega Pyroar. Each Pokemon on this team that is of the majority gender, or is Pyroar, gains a damage bonus equal to 10% times the number of Pokemon of that gender, plus 10%.

quetta.name: QUETTA
quetta.desc: All team members lose their held item and gain +20 in all of their base stats, except HP.

return.name: RETURN

rise.name: RISE
rise.desc: When this Pokemon KOs another Pokemon, its highest stat is raised by 1.

rubber.name: RUBBER
rubber.desc: This team is immune to Electric-type moves, and gains the Magic Bounce effect on switch-in.

screen.name: SCREEN
screen.desc: When a team member switches in, if its highest raw stat is Defense, it will summon Reflect, and Light Screen if SpD is the highest raw stat. When it does this, it will remove the previous screens. These screens cannot be extended by Light Clay.

shower.name: SHOWER
shower.desc: The last Pokemon on this team has Drizzle on top of its regular Ability.

sips.name: SIPS
sips.desc: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves.

sleuth.name: SLEUTH
sleuth.desc: Reveals all team members, items, and moves of the opponent. All active pokemon are identified (Ghost types are not immune to Normal/Fighting).

spooky.name: SPOOKY
spooky.desc: All Pokemon on this team are Ghost type and take 0.75x damage from Dark and Ghost type moves.

stab.name: STAB
stab.desc: This Pokemon's STAB moves deal 1.1x damage.

star.name: STAR
star.desc: This Pokemon's primary type is replaced with Fairy. Its first move becomes Fairy type and its BP is boosted by 1.2x.

survey.name: SURVEY
survey.desc: The opponent's Item and Moves are revealed on switch-in.

tear.name: TEAR
tear.desc: On switch-in, lowers a random stat of the foe by 1.

tier.name: TIER
tier.desc: This Pokemon gains a damage boost based on its usage tier.

trap.name: TRAP
trap.desc: Moves used by this Pokemon trap the target.

true.name: TRUE
true.desc: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves match its primary type.

tune.name: TUNE

victor.name: VICTOR
victor.desc: This team gains one use of V-Create across the whole team, and all of its Pokemon have their accuracy multiplied by 1.1x.

warp.name: WARP
warp.desc: This Pokemon's type effectiveness is inverted when attacking.

waxy.name: WAXY
waxy.desc: At the end of each turn, this Pokemon uses Wish.

what.name: WHAT
what.desc: This Pokemon skips recharge turns after attacks, and uses their highest Attack or Special Attack for all their damaging moves.

wind.name: WIND

wizard.name: WIZARD
wizard.desc: All Pokemon on this team gain Magic Coat, Magic Powder, and Magic Room as extra moves.

zigzag.name: ZIGZAG
zigzag.desc: If a Pokemon on this team selects a different move than the previous turn, it gains 25% damage reduction and a 20% damage boost.

arctic.name: ARCTIC
arctic.desc: Ice-type Pokemon on this team treat neutral hits as resisted. Pokemon with Snow Warning also take 33% less damage from super effective hits.

chaos.name: CHAOS
chaos.desc: Pokemon on this team use Metronome at the end of each of their turns.

chroma.name: CHROMA
chroma.desc: Pokemon on this team have their stats (except Speed) multiplied by 1 + (0.5 * number of allies sharing their Pokedex color).

climax.name: CLIMAX
climax.desc: When this team has 1 Pokemon remaining, it gains +1 Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed on switch-in.

cobras.name: COBRAS
cobras.desc: All active Pokemon gain Poison-type and the effects of Corrosion.

coven.name: COVEN
coven.desc: Pokemon on this team gain Magic Guard and Mystical Fire as an extra move.

cowboy.name: COWBOY

forest.name: FOREST
forest.desc: This team's Grass-type moves inflict Forest's Curse on targets.

god.name: GOD
god.desc: Fills the final 3 team slots with Arceus forms copying the primary type and moveset (without set codes) of the first 3 Pokemon. Normal Arceus copies the slot's item (excluding Mega Stones and Z-Crystals), while other types hold their matching Plate. All Arceus have 31 IVs and 84 EVs in every stat.

groovy.name: GROOVY
groovy.desc: At the start of every 3rd turn, all active Pokemon use a random Dance move (excluding Lunar Dance).

inject.name: INJECT
inject.desc: The last unfainted Pokemon on this team gains the effect of a random 4-letter move code from an ally.

latios.name: LATIOS
latios.desc: This team's Dragon- and Psychic-type moves deal 1.2x damage, and the first Pokemon sent out gains Levitate.

lowest.name: LOWEST
lowest.desc: When a Pokemon on this team switches in, its lowest stat is raised by 1 stage.

misty.name: MISTY
misty.desc: Mist is active on both sides for the duration of battle, boosting Water-type moves by 1.2x (While Mist is active). While Misty Terrain is active, Fairy-type moves are boosted by 1.2x.

muscle.name: MUSCLE
muscle.desc: Fighting-type Pokemon on this team have all of their natural abilities active at once.

papers.name: PAPERS

silent.name: SILENT

stone.name: STONE

suivez.name: SUIVEZ
suivez.desc: Using a Sound move grants a non-stacking 1.2x team-wide boost to moves of that move's type. Multiple type boosts can be active simultaneously.

gatr.name: GATR
